words.gloss_range: temporal recall particle opening the remembered scene and carrying a causal inspection pressure
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) opens the ayah as a remembered scene, not as a loose time marker. It carries the movement from the divine reminder and confession in 5:111 into the disciples' own exposed speech in 5:112, so the coming question is already inside a frame of recollection and evaluation. The particle can also let the remembered moment function as a reason their confession must be inspected.

words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) is a plain Form I speech verb before a plural subject, so the singular form is standard VSO grammar rather than a single disciple speaking. It compresses the disciples into one reportable utterance and opens their quoted address and question. Because the same verb returns for Jesus' reply, this first instance helps set the ayah as a two-voice exchange. That exchange belongs to Surah 5's testimonial and legal speech register, so the dialogue is not mere narrative ornament.

words.root_gloss_range: descent, sending down, alighting, revelation, and provision; locally the requested sending-down of the table
words.prose: {{ar:يُنَزِّلَ}} ({{tr:yunazzila}}) is dependent and subjunctive after an, so the disciples place a potential descent inside their question. The {{ar:ن ز ل}} ({{tr:n-z-l}}) field links the table to descent language used for revelation and provision, not merely downward movement. Form II gives the standard reading a weighty or staged sending-down nuance, while the Form IV variant narrows the contrast toward a single causative sending; later 5:114-115 carry this descent language into prayer, answer, and warning. The request also resembles the proof-from-heaven demand in 4:153, where heavenly descent language exposes spiritual audacity.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle opening an uncertain faith test after the imperative
words.prose: {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) opens the condition after the imperative and keeps the disciples' faith status grammatically open. The rebuke is not 'when you are believers' but 'if you are believers,' so the confession of 5:111 is retested rather than simply accepted. Because the command comes before the condition, taqwā becomes the proof of the faith claim. The phrase also belongs to a wider conditional-faith formula, including 5:23 and 5:57, and the nasal sound binds the particle into kuntum at the close.

topics.headline: if reopens claimed faith status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jesus' 'if' tests the belief declaration of 5:111 instead of assuming it.
topics.reason: The conditional particle and boundary row support uncertainty rather than assumed certainty.

topics.headline: taqwā command becomes proof of belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command precedes the condition, making God-conscious restraint the proof of claimed faith.
topics.reason: Clause order ties the imperative to the faith condition.

topics.headline: wider conditional-faith formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this wording belongs to a wider Quranic test formula, including 5:23 and 5:57.
topics.reason: The source row gives concrete formula references.

topics.headline: nasal sound binds condition to kuntum
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sound-binding of the condition into the state verb.
topics.reason: The phonetic row supports the tight final condition.

words.gloss_range: perfect second-person plural state verb in the conditional clause, testing an already claimed state
words.root_gloss_range: being, existing, and becoming; locally a completed-state probe of the addressed group
words.prose: {{ar:كُنتُم}} ({{tr:kuntum}}) turns the condition directly back onto the addressed group. Its perfect second-person plural form tests an already claimed state: whether they have truly been believers, not whether they might become so later. The verb carries the boundary from declaration in 5:111 into conditional being in 5:112. In the closing phrase, the clustered m/n sounds tighten the final condition.

topics.headline: second-person plural turns rebuke back on the speakers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition targets the whole group who asked, not an abstract audience.
topics.reason: The -tum ending marks the addressed plural group.

topics.headline: perfect tense probes already claimed being
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jesus tests whether belief has been their real state up to this point.
topics.reason: The perfect form in the conditional supports established-state probing.

topics.headline: 5:111 confession becomes 5:112 state test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from declared belief in 5:111 to conditional being in 5:112.
topics.reason: The boundary rows tie the local verb to the prior confession.

topics.headline: nasal cluster tightens final condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the tightened sound at the close of the condition.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is retained as secondary closure.

words.gloss_range: Form IV active participle predicate of kuntum, closing the ayah on believer identity
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, faith, and giving safety; locally ongoing believer status under condition
words.prose: {{ar:مُّؤْمِنِينَ}} ({{tr:muʾminīna}}) is the accusative predicate of kuntum and the ayah's final word. From {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}), believer identity carries trust, security, and entrusted faith, not bare assent. The active participle makes the status ongoing, while the boundary with 5:111 turns an earlier declaration of belief into a criterion tested by speech and taqwā. The extended īn and nasal closure leave that faith test resonating after the table request has disappeared from the ending.

topics.headline: final predicate names tested status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word names the status whose truth is under condition.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes muʾminīna the predicate of kuntum.

topics.headline: believer identity as ongoing trust and security
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that believer identity means ongoing entrusted trust and security, not a one-time claim.
topics.reason: The ʾ-m-n range and active participle form support ongoing identity.

topics.headline: faith status ethically tested by taqwā
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the answer to the table request is a diagnostic test of faith through taqwā.
topics.reason: The closing convergence row ties the imperative, condition, and believer identity together.

topics.headline: 5:111 belief becomes 5:112 criterion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earlier declaration in 5:111 is carried over as a criterion at the end of 5:112.
topics.reason: Concrete 5:111 to 5:112 rows support the boundary payoff.

topics.reason: The final-position and phonetic rows support the closing accent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two speaking acts at words 2 and 16 frame the disciples at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated speech opens a proposal and closes with an answer, while the disciples' root carries both support and conversational return. The request is therefore staged as negotiation within an existing allegiance, not as an isolated proposition.

activation_trace.role: Negotiating an affair makes the doubled speaking acts function as proposal and answer.
The helper image supplies the speakers' prior relation of support to Jesus.
Conversational return turns their title into a live back-and-forth mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The disciples make a miracle demand and Jesus rebukes them.
changed_reading.after: Committed helpers table a negotiable request, and Jesus answers by marking the faith-boundary within which such speech must remain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The question construction at words 7-9 joins yastati'u to rabbuka.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ability branch of t-w-' gives the surface question, but neighboring branches retain agreement and compliant availability; r-b-b adds both sovereignty and gradual care. The wording can probe whether lordly governance will accommodate the request as well as whether the act can occur.

activation_trace.role: Ability and enablement supply the direct modal force of the question.
Agreement and mutual accommodation keep willingness relationally active behind the modal form.
Sovereignty makes raw inability an unstable reading of the addressed Lord.
Cultivation and completion recast the requested act as possible lordly care.

changed_reading.before: They ask whether God has enough power to send the table.
changed_reading.after: Their grammatically modal question also sounds for lordly willingness or accommodation, which explains why Jesus answers their posture rather than supplying a technical statement about power.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence at words 11-15 asks that a ma'idah be delivered upon the group from the sky.
baseline_models.mechanism: Descent is not mere downward motion: its delivery branch carries something to recipients. The table root combines a food-bearing surface with nourishment and benefit, while the sky supplies the overhanging source. Together they form a vertical transfer of provision.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent as delivery supplies the transfer from source to recipients.
Feeding, benefit, and gift make the delivered object functional provision.
The food-bearing tray fixes the request in a concrete shared object.
What is above and overhangs supplies the elevated origin of the transfer.

changed_reading.before: The requested table is a spectacular object arriving from heaven.
changed_reading.after: The request seeks a concrete delivery of sustaining benefit from an elevated source into the group's shared reach.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Jesus' reply at words 17-21 binds guarding oneself before God to the claim of being believers.
baseline_models.mechanism: W-q-y makes piety an active placement of the self behind protection, while faith combines trusting security and settled assent. The conditional reply tests whether the request issues from that protected confidence or destabilizes it.

activation_trace.role: Putting the self into protection makes the imperative regulate the requester's stance.
Heart-security and trust supply the stable condition against which the request is measured.
Assent that settles the heart makes belief more than appetite for proof.

changed_reading.before: Jesus tells them simply to fear God.
changed_reading.after: Jesus requires the request itself to remain inside a protected, trusting mode of belief rather than becoming a substitute for it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier context couples eating apportioned provision with guarding God, then turns food into expiatory feeding of others. That sequence strengthens the focus table as received sustenance whose proper reception carries distributive and ethical obligation.

activation_trace.role: The focus table's feeding, benefit, and gift branch anchors the contextual food economy in the requested object.
Actual consumption makes divine provision something received bodily, not merely viewed.
The apportioned gift frames food as assigned provision from a giver.
Feeding another and seeking food extend reception into reparative distribution.

structural_cues: 5:88 places eating, provision, guarding God, and belief in one instruction.
5:89 makes feeding ten needy people a concrete means of repairing a bound oath.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lawful eating, apportioned provision, and compensatory feeding; I infer that heavenly provision enters the same receive-and-share economy. A live alternative is that the table remains a private miraculous meal with no distributive implication.

changed_reading.before: The table is a gift the disciples want to consume.
changed_reading.after: The table is entrusted provision: eating it would also place its recipients under the ethics of guarded reception and food-sharing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context uses t-w-' for commanded obedience, but closes with distinct roots for sovereignty and effective power. That lexical distribution revises the focus modal from a stable allegation of incapacity toward a relational question of compliance or availability, while leaving its provocative surface intact.

activation_trace.role: Agreement and accommodation anchor the willingness-side of the focus question.
Ability remains the direct surface reading that the context must revise rather than erase.
Explicit obedience foregrounds relational compliance within the same root field.
Final sovereignty supplies uncontested dominion over the scene of the request.
Effective enablement to act gives the pericope an explicit capacity term distinct from the focus root.

structural_cues: 5:115 narrates the exact descent as an announced act, resolving whether it can occur.
5:120 closes the packet by assigning all dominion to God and declaring power over every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies t-w-' for both the focus modal and obedience, then m-l-k and q-d-r for final dominion and power; I infer a purposeful lexical contrast. The live alternative is the ordinary capacity sense used provocatively and then corrected by the narrative.

changed_reading.before: The disciples straightforwardly doubt whether God can perform the descent.
changed_reading.after: Their wording remains risky, but the wider root distribution makes 'will your Lord accommodate this?' a coexisting reading, while final sovereignty rules out actual lack of power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly makes accessible objects reveal hidden allegiance: a test manifests the person's state, questions can become disclosed material, and prior askers become rejecters. Once the requested descent is granted, concealment of the gift leads to exceptional punishment. Jesus' warning therefore marks a threshold before desire becomes irreversible evidence and liability.

activation_trace.role: Self-protection anchors Jesus' reply as a warning before the request changes the requesters' exposure.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the reveal-and-liability mechanism.
Questioning and requesting establish the hazardous initiating act.
Delivery through descent links asking to the moment concealed material becomes present.
A prior community's request supplies the precedent for the focus request.
Covering the truth supplies the failed response that follows the precedent request.
The announced delivery crosses the request from hypothetical speech into received fact.
Covering a blessing makes post-delivery rejection specifically a failure of reception.
Punitive pain supplies the exceptional consequence attached to rejection after descent.

structural_cues: 5:101 links repeated asking to disclosure during a descent.
5:115 places fulfilled descent before the warning of unmatched punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered chain of test, asking, disclosure, rejection, fulfilled descent, and punishment; I infer that greater manifestation raises responsibility. A live alternative is that the punishment warning is specific to this table without expressing a general evidentiary threshold.

changed_reading.before: Jesus' warning is a generic rebuke for an improper miracle request.
changed_reading.after: Jesus warns before a consequential transaction: if the requested proof arrives, the requesters move from protected uncertainty into exposed knowledge and heightened liability.

context_deltas.mechanism: A legal sequence first disciplines testimony, the disciples then ask to be witnessed as submitted, and their stated purpose for the table joins eating to knowing truthful fulfillment and becoming witnesses. The table becomes a material exhibit that converts reported promise into observed, accountable knowledge.

activation_trace.role: The concrete food-bearing surface anchors the evidentiary model in a touchable focus object.
Testimony stated from knowledge supplies the packet's formal evidentiary frame.
Bringing testimony correctly reinforces accountable articulation of known fact.
Presence with observation frames witness as a requested confirmation of the disciples' submission.
Disclosure to the knower states the epistemic change the table is meant to produce.
Fulfillment in act turns Jesus' prior speech into verifiable performance.
Observed presence names the role the eaters seek to acquire around the table.
Benefit as the opposite of harm gives truthful witness an ultimate consequential payoff.
Completed and stable truth closes the evidentiary arc opened by their request to know.

structural_cues: 5:106-108 immediately precedes the scene with procedures for producing and correcting testimony.
5:111 has the disciples declare belief and ask that their submission be witnessed.
5:113 explicitly coordinates eating, heart-rest, knowing truth, and becoming witnesses.
5:119 makes truthfulness beneficial on the final day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly joins the table to knowing and witnessing; I infer that eating establishes embodied presence to the exhibit and intensifies accountability. A live alternative is a devotional sign without the legal coloring carried from 5:106-108.

changed_reading.before: The disciples want reassurance that Jesus has spoken truthfully.
changed_reading.after: They ask for a consumable exhibit that will turn hearers into participant-witnesses, so reassurance also creates a duty to testify truthfully.

context_deltas.mechanism: Jesus repeats the requested table but assigns it three functions: a returning festal condition spanning first and last, a visible sign, and provision. A single descent is thereby stretched into communal memory whose recurrence keeps gift and evidence together.

activation_trace.role: The focus food-bearing table supplies the concrete event that can be memorialized.
The requested delivery supplies the originating event from which recurrence can proceed.
A feast as a condition that returns converts one meal into repeatable communal time.
The visible mark keeps the meal legible as sign rather than ordinary consumption.
Apportioned gift preserves the table's material provision within its memorial function.

structural_cues: 5:114 repeats the focus descent-table-sky construction in Jesus' own prayer.
The purpose clause spans the community's first and last members before naming sign and provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a feast rooted in return plus first-to-last scope; I infer ritualized communal memory beyond the first eating. A live alternative is one extraordinary festive occasion rather than a regularly recurring observance.

changed_reading.before: The table answers a group's immediate hunger and uncertainty.
changed_reading.after: Jesus reformulates it as an identity-bearing memorial: provision and sign recur in communal time from first members to last.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a conventional table noun need not activate its root's motion image. It remains anchored in the focus ma'idah and gains a direct contextual counter-image when the disciples say their hearts should become still. Downstream prose should present it as a packet-induced material polarity, not as the noun's required lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus table at word 13 carries an available m-y-d image of movement and oscillation.

activation_trace.role: Movement, swaying, and instability make the table's root carry the condition to be reversed.
Stillness and reassurance supply the explicit inward endpoint sought from the table.
Turning something from its face gives the heart a latent image of reversibility that stillness arrests.

changed_reading.before: A stable table descends to reassure uncertain hearts.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the moving or swaying table is the external motion that stops inward turning: material descent converts oscillation into heart-rest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant s-t-' mapping for yastati'u. It remains valid as an activation because that mapped target is explicitly supplied and converges with the focus's own descent and height lexemes. Downstream prose should label it a cross-root spatial experiment, never a translation of yastati'u.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places yastati'u at word 8 inside a request for descent at word 11 from the height at word 15.

activation_trace.role: Extension and rising into the air give the request an exploratory upward-reaching vector.
Downward movement and settling supply the answering vector.
Height fixes the upper domain toward which the request reaches and from which the table descends.

changed_reading.before: The verse poses an abstract question about ability and asks for a downward miracle.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial activation, the human question reaches upward while the gift travels downward, making the table the meeting point of crossed vertical vectors.

strongest_changes: The table shifts from spectacle to entrusted provision whose reception carries food ethics.
The request becomes a threshold that converts uncertainty into witnessed knowledge and heightened liability.
Eating the table becomes participation in an evidentiary exhibit, not only private reassurance.
Jesus' prayer stretches one meal into a sign-bearing communal memorial spanning first and last.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made one concrete food object perform several mechanisms without collapsing them: nourishment, guarded testing, embodied testimony, recurring memory, and the exploratory reversal from movement to heart-rest.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus modal can still be heard as ordinary capacity language even after context strengthens willingness and accommodation.
The feast's return image may indicate a single festive occasion rather than regular recurrence.
The motion image in ma'idah and the non-dominant s-t-' mapping are useful activations but should not be promoted to lexical glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Practical capacity is tested by requested descent.** `ط و ع B003` is practical ability, `ن ز ل B002` sending down, `م ي د B004` the food-bearing table, and `س م و B004` overhead sky/cover. The question seeks a visible transfer from above to below. I infer that the warning (`و ق ي B002`) redirects attention from divine capacity to the requesters' capacity to bear the sign.
2. **The table also counters swaying.** `م ي د B001` is rocking motion, while `B004` is the table. Exploratorily, the requested stable food-surface answers inward instability, a link confirmed explicitly by the desired calm in 5:113.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Declared faith is pressed into a capacity question and demand for descending provision.** Fixed **ط و ع / B003** (“ability and practical capacity”) activates in *yastaṭīʿu*, while fixed **م ي د / B004** (“food-bearing table or tray”) gives the requested proof an edible surface. 5:111 records their witnessed belief; 5:113 names the unrest and knowledge they want the meal to resolve, and 5:115 attaches exceptional liability after descent. I infer that the request shifts trust from received address toward a publicly consumable demonstration. Jesus’s command to guard reads as warning about the obligation such proof will create.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:113 named the question’s inward motive, and 5:115 confirmed Jesus’s warning by attaching exceptional liability to the fulfilled descent.

Dallar, kişilerin boyun eğmesi ve uyumundan güç yetirme, kendini zorlama, gönüllü iyilik, iç yöneliş ve otlak ya da meyvenin kullanılabilir hale gelmesine açılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin havada uzaması, yükselmesi veya yayılması ortak ekseninde ışık, şimşek, toz, koku, sabah aydınlığı ve ok örneklerini bir araya getirir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu hareket ve görünüş çekirdeğini doğru biçimde yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın kullanımdaki havada uzama, yükselme ve yayılma çekirdeğini verir; okun gökte belirmesi ve kokunun buruna ulaşması gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımlar ayrı yüzler olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin havaya doğru uzaması, yükselmesi ya da çevreye yayılmasıdır. Işık, şimşek, sabah aydınlığı, toz ve koku bu görünüşle anlatılır; okun gökte belirmesi ve kokunun buruna ulaşması bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: Bir şey havada uzar, yükselir veya çevreye yayılır.
Işık, şimşek ve sabah aydınlığı göğe doğru yükselerek ya da uzanarak görünür.
Toz ve koku yükselip havaya yayılır.
Atılan ok gökte yükselip belirginleşir ve parlar.
Yayılan güzel koku kişinin burnuna ulaşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı havada uzama, yükselme ve yayılmayı temel alır; ışık ve şimşek gibi görünen olguların yanı sıra toz ve koku da bu çekirdeğe bağlanır. Tahdhib, atılan okun gökte yükselip belirginleşmesini ve kokunun yayılıp duyulmasını özel örnekler olarak ayrıca verir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ربا الشيء إذا زاد أو ارتفع، وربت الأرض إذا انتفخت وزادت، والرابي الزائد أو العالي، وأربى عليه إذا أشرف أو زاد عليه.
يدخل فيه الربوة والرابية والرباوة والرباة وما ارتفع من الأرض، مع اختلاف لغات الكلمة.
يدخل فيه الربا في البيع أو القرض، والزيادة على رأس المال، والربية لغة أو اسم خاص للربا.
يدخل فيه الربو بمعنى النفس العالي أو البهر أو الانبهار، وما يصيب الإنسان أو الدابة من علو النفس أو الانتفاخ من مشي أو عدو أو فزع.
يدخل فيه ربيت الولد أو تربيته بمعنى غذوته، وربا الولد أو الزرع بالنماء، وربوت أو ربيت في القوم بمعنى نشأت فيهم.
يدخل فيه الأربية أو الأربيتان بمعنى أصل الفخذ أو لحمتين ناتئتين في أصول الفخذين من باطن.
يدخل فيه قولهم جاء في أربية قومه أي في أهل بيته من بني الأعمام ونحوهم.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.
